publicSources.evidence: The notice gives 32.3350, -81.0322 near Red Dam Road in Hardeeville, Jasper County. It describes expanding the existing Okatie 115kV station to 230/115kV and folding in Jasper–Yemassee 230kV, matching the supplied project scope.

decisions.matchReason: Named station, voltage conversion, named transmission line, utility and county context agree. Proposed source-point remains unverified and represents the permit area rather than a surveyed center.
